title: Anthropic confirms new Claude Code limits "to steer it away from recreating someone else's specific game", saying IP infringement is against its usage policy (Bruno Ferreira/Tom's Hardware)
summary: Bruno Ferreira / Tom's Hardware: Anthropic confirms new Claude Code limits “to steer it away from recreating someone else's specific game”, saying IP infringement is against its usage policy — Meanwhile, we now have direct reports of reverse engineering efforts being blocked, while online complaints grow.
